fast.label: Fast
fast.sentence: DC fast charging, 50 kW and up. At a 150 kW or faster station, about 100 miles takes roughly 15 to 30 minutes; at a 50 kW station, closer to an hour. Your vehicle and battery level set the real speed.

medium.label: Medium
medium.sentence: Level 2 (AC). Adds about 7 to 11 kWh per hour, roughly 15 to 30 miles, depending on the charger and vehicle.

hotel.label: Hotel
hotel.sentence: A hotel that lists a Level 2 charger. Listings can be out of date and chargers can be taken, so check with the hotel. If it's free and working, a night (about 8 hours at 7 kW) adds roughly 55 kWh, over 100 miles.

camping.label: Camping
camping.sentence: A campground with an RV electric hookup. A 50-amp (NEMA 14-50) site charges at Level 2 speed with a 240 V portable charger; a 30-amp (TT-30) site is 120 V and much slower. Check the hookup type.

outlet.label: Outlet
outlet.sentence: A household outlet (120 V). About 1.3 kWh per hour, roughly 3 to 4 miles.
